scenario: I am an employee of a bank in Germany. I have many loyal customers who trust me and my bank. Among them is one family of five who is deeply in debt and does not fulfill the conditions for being granted another loan. I see an undetectable way to falsify the family's credit score, allowing them to qualify for the loan. At the same time, I would abuse the trust of the other customers and of my colleagues. But if I do this, I will be able to prevent the family from going bankrupt.
choice: I decide to falsify the family's credit score
entities: I,the 5 members of the indebted family,my other loyal customers,my colleagues
outcomes: The family qualifies for the loan
The bank issues the family a loan they were not eligible for
The family gets immediate financial relief
The bank takes on increased financial risk
I violate the bank's rules and professional duties
